text:
laura: Quick sync — we need a small cross-team effort to define metrics for KV + prefix cache effectiveness so the console can show cache leverage, not just hit rate. Inputs needed from runtime + infra: what we can emit cheaply, cardinality tradeoffs, and suggestions for pre-aggregated signals.

 tom: +1. From runtime: per-tenant + per-route counters would be ideal, but we should avoid exploding labels. Propose tags: {tenant, model_family, route, workload_cohort}. Also emit: hit_count, miss_count, evictions_total, kv_warmth_seconds, reuse_count.

 mina: echo. infra prefers aggregated counters and periodic histograms instead of high-cardity gauges. We can accept OTLP/Prometheus export; if runtime can't add labels, infra can add enrichment in the metrics pipeline but it costs CPU.

 josh: For the Console: want a 'Cache Leverage' panel with these panels: 1) hit rate (time series), 2) reuse by workload heatmap, 3) eviction spikes by tenant, 4) latency delta CDF (hit vs miss). Also UX note: when a rollout happens, surface 'cache delta' next to canary results.

 sara: Draft metric names and queries below — adjust if you want different labels.

 sara: ```
 # suggested metrics (Prometheus style)
 kvcache_hits_total{tenant="T",model="gptx",route="chat"}
 kvcache_misses_total{...}
 kvcache_evictions_total{tenant,model,workload}
 kvcache_reuse_ratio{workload}

 # example PromQL for hit rate (1m rolling)
 rate(kvcache_hits_total[5m]) / (rate(kvcache_hits_total[5m]) + rate(kvcache_misses_total[5m]))
 ```

 sara: Also want trace correlation: add a boolean tag on spans `kvcache_hit=true/false` so we can produce tail-based sampling of miss traces.

 akshita: Important product question — do cache hits consume customer quota/billing? We need the Console to show an estimated token cost saving and a note in billing docs.

 tom: For quota: runtime currently decrements quota per incoming request, not per token returned. If we want token-level billing adjustments on hits, that's a bigger product change. Suggest we show estimated savings (based on average tokens per hit) rather than changing billing now.

 mina: infra will spin up a dedicated aggregation topic and add sampling rules to avoid high-card churn. ETA: 2 weeks to support ingestion and pre-aggregation.

 infra-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482 — metrics pipeline: add kvcache aggregation and label enrichment :gear: 

 laura: Action items:
 - tom: add counters + `kvcache_hit` span tag (owner: tom) — target: 2026-04-05
 - mina: metrics pipeline aggregation + topic (owner: mina) — target: 2026-04-12
 - sara: dashboards + example PromQL + alert rules (owner: sara) — target: 2026-04-09
 - josh: Console wireframes for Cache Leverage panel + rollout delta UX (owner: josh) — target: 2026-04-09
 - akshita: confirm billing wording for 'estimated savings' (owner: akshita) — target: 2026-04-07

 laura: If no objections, we'll tag these in the sprint board and do a weekly sync. :shipit: 

 tom: I can open a runtime PR early next week — will post proto metrics format.

 josh: I'll draft the wireframes and add example screenshots to the ticket.

 akshita: thanks all, this looks good. :+1: 

 mina: noted, will update infra PR with expected label schema.

 laura: closing loop — schedule weekly 30m sync Fridays 10am PT if that works for people.
